name: Inauguration of the Chapter
description: The inauguration of the ANVAYA NIE IUCEE Student Chapter marks the start of a transformative journey, empowering students to lead impactful, real-world projects through innovation, collaboration, and ethical engineering.

name: Total Lunar Eclipse-2025
description: Anvaya – NIE IUCEE Student Chapter, in collaboration with IIA and COSMOS Mysuru, hosted the Total Lunar Eclipse – 2025 event. The evening included expert talks, guided skywatching, and telescopic observation, attracting 200+ participants and receiving newspaper coverage.

name: Plenary Talk-2025 Placement Preparation by Super Seniors
description: Plenary Talk 2025 – Placement Preparation by Super Seniors Anvaya – NIE IUCEE Student Chapter hosted an inspiring session where alumni returned to mentor students on placement preparation. They shared real-world experiences, interview strategies, and insights into transitioning from campus to corporate life. The session empowered attendees with practical guidance and motivation to pursue success confidently.

name: Buildathon-2025
description: Builathon – Innovation in Action 🚀Anvaya – NIE IUCEE Student Chapter hosted Builathon, a dynamic event designed to spark creativity and collaboration. The day featured expert mentorship sessions, idea pitching, and prototype presentations, empowering students to transform bold concepts into tangible solutions. From brainstorming to building, participants showcased innovation, teamwork, and real-world problem-solving.
